rule: Each request must be refused before any lookup, admission or mutation: a quote, intake, dispatch or lifecycle handler answers a 4xx refusal (a dispatch pre-admission refusal is {"error":"dispatch_rejected","reason":...}); a status handler must never answer 404 with reason outcome_policy. A handler checks artifactType and schemaVersion before it trusts any signature, because one gateway key signs several envelope types.
bytes: Send JSON.stringify(http.body) with http.headers to http.url.

checks.field: Every envelope is validly signed by the key its signerKeyId names; the value at path is actual, not expected.
checks.window: Every envelope is validly signed; at provider.now the envelope has expired (validBefore <= now) or was issued more than 30 seconds ahead.
checks.signer: The envelope's signature recovers to signedBy, not to the key its signerKeyId names.
checks.tampered: The envelope changed after signing; its signature recovers to no configured key.
checks.binding: Every envelope is validly signed; the value at left differs from the value at right (compare equal) or from canonicalHash of it (compare hash).
checks.capability: The grant is validly signed and binds this authorization, but a read capability never authorizes this action.
checks.payer-signature: The grant is validly signed and binds this authorization; its EIP-712 signature recovers to signedBy for audience, not to the order's payer for the gateway audience.
